en: Ask for 3–5 variants on different bets: minimal / dense / progressive disclosure / smart defaults / opt-out.

en: Not “which looks nicer.” Score three: ① UX principles ② idioms of this stack ③ design-system fit.

zh: 7.3 · 四個常見誤區
en: 7.3 · Four recurring mistakes

zh: POC 階段最容易翻車的，通常不是「AI 生得差」，而是你怎麼處置 AI 交出來的東西。下面四個，現場幾乎都會踩到一次。
en: POC rarely fails because “AI generated badly.” It fails on what you do with the output. These four show up in almost every room.

zh: 誤區
en: Mistake

zh: 你會看到什麼
en: What you see

zh: 怎麼改
en: Fix

zh: 沒先講產品形態
en: No stack up front

zh: 網頁樣式 + 手機手勢 + 後台表格拼在一起的「四不像」
en: A chimera: web chrome + mobile gestures + admin tables taped together

zh: 開口第一句就寫：哪種產品、主要螢幕、有沒有設計規範
en: First line of the prompt: which product, primary screen, design system or not

zh: 每個方案都覺得不錯
en: Every variant looks fine

en: Write 3 selection criteria before you generate

zh: 把多方案直接當交付
en: Ship variants as the deliverable

zh: 整包丟進 Figma；工程師一做發現邏輯破洞，回頭重做
en: Dump the lot into Figma; engineering finds logic holes and rebuilds

en: Variants are material. Pick 1 into Figma for polish, and finish the spec

zh: 不寫為什麼這樣選
en: No written reason

zh: 三週後同樣決策重來一輪；新人問「為什麼」沒人答得出
en: Three weeks later the same decision restarts. A new hire asks “why?” and nobody can answer.

zh: 第 5 步是關卡：沒決策紀錄，不准開下一個功能
en: Step 5 is a hard gate: no decision log, no next feature

en: Who owns the “stack idioms / constraints” you wrote into the corpus? Stack knowledge from a client project: can you take it when you leave / close?

zh: 邊界矩陣 · distill: · 揭露「工具」欄
en: Boundary matrix · distill: · disclosure “tools” column

zh: 多方案 → 判準篩選 → 決策日誌
en: Variants → criteria → decision log

zh: 真正被蒸餾的常常不是畫面，是「為什麼選 B 不選 A」。沒 log＝沒有可歸屬的知識；有 log 才問得了歸屬。
en: What actually gets distilled is rarely the screen—it is “why B, not A.” No log = no attributable knowledge. A log is what makes ownership askable.

zh: 四個誤區：沒講形態、選不下來、當交付、不寫理由

zh: 全是透明度失敗模式—對內說不清來源與把關，對外更交不出揭露聲明。

en: §03–§07 are the claims. §08 does not rehash them. One question: what keeps this 90 minutes from collapsing? Three pieces. Drop one and it fails.

en: — M2→M3 · why “UX spec → UI,” not “screenshot → UI”

en: Someone asks “what about Screenshot→Figma / Design＋Build?”

en: ③ Design lanescreens · no data

en: Screens · variants · clickable prototypee.g. 3 layouts side by side; buttons click, nothing hits the DB

en: ④ POC + Red Teamtest behavior · only after Design ships screens

en: ← Skip the spec, open the canvase.g. only “design a grading-review page” → AI invents pages / modules / flows

en: ← One-click reverse-engineer screens into a design systeme.g. export generated swatches as tokens → reuse next time → hallucination becomes truth

zh: ① 文件是起點 · 截圖只是並排參考
en: ① Spec is the start · screenshots are side-by-side refs

zh: ② 參考素材照用 · ④ POC+Red Team 測行為形狀
en: ② Use refs as refs · ④ POC+Red Team tests behavior shape

en: ③ Design＝screens · ⑤ Build＝runnable

en: Ban · skip spec, open canvas · reverse-engineer screens as the system

en: Plain-language map · what each row actually means (same case: AI grading-review page)

en: Row

en: What it looks like in the case

en: Common misread

zh: ① UX 文件
en: ① UX spec

zh: 動手畫之前，先把「要做什麼」寫成文字。不用漂亮，能讀就行。
en: Write “what we’re building” before you draw. Ugly is fine. Readable is enough.

zh: 寫一行：「頁：登入／班級列表／複核頁／匯出。模組：OCR 比對、評分規則、覆核。流程：先看異常題→對照原圖→改分→送出→組長審核。」
en: One line: “Pages: login / class list / review / export. Modules: OCR match, scoring rules, review. Flow: flag → original image → rescore → submit → lead reviews.”

zh: 「文件太慢，先畫畫看」—結果 AI 自己發明頁跟流程
en: “Spec is slow—just sketch first”—AI invents the pages and the flow

zh: ② 參考素材
en: ② Reference material

zh: 看別人怎麼做的，找靈感。可以截圖、套模板、打一句 Prompt。但這些是參考，不是你家的決策。
en: Look at how others did it. Screenshots, templates, a one-line prompt are fine. They are refs, not your call.

zh: Mobbin 查 Classroom 怎麼列作業；套一個後台表格版型；打「設計閱卷複核頁」讓 AI 出三個方向。
en: Mobbin: how Classroom lists assignments. Drop in an admin table. Prompt “design a grading-review page” for three directions.

zh: 「截圖抄過來就是我們的設計系統」—抄到的是長相，不是判斷
en: “Paste the screenshot, that’s our design system”—you copied looks, not judgment

zh: ③ Design 道
en: ③ Design lane

zh: 把文件裡的判斷畫成畫面。按鈕能點，但按了不會真的存資料。
en: Draw the spec’s judgments as screens. Buttons click. Nothing actually saves.

zh: 3 個版面並排：左 OCR 原圖、中學生作答、右 AI 分數。按「改分」跳視窗，但分數沒進 DB。
en: 3 layouts side by side: OCR original | student answer | AI score. “Rescore” opens a modal. Score never hits the DB.

zh: 「畫面能點＝做完了」—能點跟能跑是兩件事
en: “Clickable = done”—clickable ≠ runnable

zh: Design 出完畫面後進場。讓 AI 扮演使用者跑一遍旅程，測「行為形狀」對不對—不是測真實動機。
en: Enter after Design ships screens. AI plays the user through the journey. Test behavior shape, not real motive.

zh: Perplexity 扮老師跑「看異常題→對照原圖→改分→送出」；卡在哪、哪步猜錯，寫回 log。測完才決定要不要進 Build。
en: Perplexity as teacher: flag → original image → rescore → submit. Where it stalls, where it guesses wrong, write back to the log. Then decide whether to enter Build.

zh: 「POC 通過＝用戶研究」—heuristic 驗證≠用戶研究，對外必依 §05 揭露
en: “POC pass = user research”—heuristic check ≠ research. Disclose under §05.

zh: ⑤ Build 道
en: ⑤ Build lane

zh: 把畫面接上真的資料、登入、付款。這一步才算產品，而且要審核。
en: Wire screens to real data, login, pay. This is the product. It still needs review.

zh: 老師用學校帳號登入→改完分數寫進 DB→送出後組長看得到→匯出 Excel。
en: Teacher logs in with school account → rescore hits DB → lead can see it after submit → export Excel.

zh: 「Design 畫完就交付」—沒接資料的畫面，工程師還是從頭做
en: “Design screens = ship”—unwired screens, engineering still starts from scratch

zh: 禁區 A
en: Forbidden A

zh: 跳過 ① 直接開 ③。AI 把沒寫的頁／模組／流程用幻覺補完。
en: Skip ①, open ③. AI hallucinates the missing pages / modules / flows.

zh: 只打「設計閱卷複核頁」→AI 自己發明「家長端」「付費解鎖」「AI 自動評語」這些你沒要的東西。
en: Prompt only “design a grading-review page” → AI invents “parent app,” “paywall,” “AI auto-comments” you never asked for.

zh: 「生成出來的看起來很完整」—完整是假的，是 AI 猜的
en: “The output looks complete”—complete is fake. AI guessed.

zh: 禁區 B
en: Forbidden B

zh: 把 ③ 的畫面一鍵反解成設計規範，下次生成直接套。等於把 AI 幻覺洗成真相。
en: One-click reverse-engineer ③ screens into a design system, reuse next generation. Hallucination laundered into truth.

zh: 把生成的色票／圓角匯出成 tokens→下次所有頁都套這組→第 10 頁跟第 1 頁各長一套，因為當初沒有語意只有數字。
en: Export generated swatches / radii as tokens → every later page uses them → page 10 and page 1 look like two systems, because you had numbers, not meaning.

zh: 「我們已經有設計系統了」—有的是一鍵匯出的色票，不是系統
en: “We already have a design system”—you have one-click swatches, not a system

en: Glossary

zh: 共通
en: Shared

zh: 名詞
en: Term

zh: 一句話
en: In one line

en: 0–6: where you actually sit. Place yourself and T1 with the §01 behavior checklist—don’t inflate from the definition.

zh: 每段都帶走東西 · Demo 先錄好 · 用了就揭露—回應不同工作流的三件事，不是講座的自我介紹
en: Every section leaves a takeaway · pre-record the demo · disclose what you used—three answers to different workflows, not the talk’s bio

en: UX spec

en: Text written before you draw: pages, modules, user path, handoffs. The talk’s start line, not a reference.

zh: Minimum Viable Product；剛好能驗證假設的最小可跑產品。Design＋Build 工具加速的是這個，不是跳過審核的藉口
en: Minimum Viable Product: the smallest runnable product that tests the hypothesis. Design＋Build speeds this up. It is not an excuse to skip review.

en: §03 · Token ledger

zh: 計費最小單位／你塞進模型的背景；塞錯層次又貴又差，所以是預算問題
en: Smallest billed unit / the context you stuff into the model. Wrong layer = expensive and worse. That’s a budget problem.

zh: 貼上 → 附檔／Project → Skill 調用 → Skill+程式；成本斷點常在 S1→S2
en: Paste → attach / Project → Skill call → Skill+code. Cost cliff is usually S1→S2

zh: 重貼 · 重造 · 整塞
en: re-paste · rebuild · dump-all

zh: 三個立即可砍的成本項；對治＝substrate+view／預設 skills+delta／分層壓縮
en: Three costs you can cut now. Counter: substrate+view / default skills+delta / layered compression

zh: 漸進揭露 / 誤觸發
en: progressive disclosure / false trigger

zh: 先宣告 skill 存在，真用才載全文；叫錯一次，全文照樣計費
en: Announce the skill exists; load the full text only on real use. One false call still bills the whole file.

zh: 機制 / 效果 · 自評 vs 量測
en: mechanism / effect · self-rate vs measure

zh: 怎麼運作看官方；省多少自己量。採購不接受「我覺得比較快」當導入依據
en: How it works: vendor docs. How much you save: measure it. Procurement will not take “feels faster” as an adoption case.

zh: Skill · 問答 / Code / Design
en: Skill · Ask / Code / Design

zh: 同一套能力三端長得不同；Design＝畫布／POC 後段，常經 /design-sync 對接 Code—不要空白畫布起手
en: Same capability, three surfaces. Design = canvas / late POC, often via /design-sync into Code—don’t start from a blank canvas.

zh: UX 文件的三個基本件：要做哪些頁、哪些功能模組、使用者怎麼走。缺定義 AI 就用幻覺補
en: Three primitives of a UX spec: pages, modules, how users move. Missing defs, AI hallucinates the rest.

zh: Agent 協作流程
en: Agent collaboration flow

zh: 人與人、人與 agent、agent 與 agent 之間誰先動、讀什麼、寫回哪、失敗怎麼接手。不會出現在 UI 幀上，卻決定產品能不能跑
en: Who moves first, what they read, where they write back, how failure is handed off—human↔human, human↔agent, agent↔agent. Never on a UI frame. Decides whether the product runs.

zh: IA（資訊架構）
en: IA (information architecture)

zh: 內容怎麼分、頁面怎麼排、使用者找東西的路徑。跟 page／module 一起寫進文件，不是畫完才補
en: How content is grouped, how pages are ordered, how users find things. Write it with page / module. Don’t patch it after you draw.

zh: wiki 裡資料的結構約定（欄位名、型態、關聯）。agent 靠它讀寫；沒 schema 的 wiki 只是筆記
en: Structure contract for wiki data (field names, types, relations). The agent reads/writes against it. A wiki with no schema is just notes.

zh: Replit Design 功能：看著你現在的畫面主動建議下一步變體，不必每次重打 Prompt。增選項，不增決策
en: Replit Design: watches the current screen and suggests next variants. No re-prompt. Adds options, not decisions.

zh: 真實產品畫面／flow 資料庫（>60 萬筆）。用途是找靈感、寫進證據層，不是抽成自家 tokens
en: Real product screens / flow corpus (>600k). Use it for inspiration and as evidence. Don’t extract it into your own tokens.

zh: Claude／Genspark／Replit 把「畫完一鍵變 App／code」縮短成一條路。Design＝視覺原型，Build＝接資料／登入／付款才可跑
en: Claude / Genspark / Replit collapse “draw then one-click App / code” into one path. Design = visual prototype. Build = data / login / pay, then it’s runnable.

zh: 反解禁令
en: No reverse-engineer

zh: 禁止把生成的 frame 一鍵反解成 Design.md／tokens 充當設計系統—那等於把 AI 幻覺洗成真相源
en: Do not one-click reverse-engineer a generated frame into Design.md / tokens as a design system—that launders AI hallucination into a source of truth.

zh: §04 · 合成用戶
en: §04 · Synthetic user

zh: 合成用戶
en: Synthetic user

zh: 用 AI 扮演使用者跑旅程，測行為的形狀。不是真實動機，替代不了用戶研究，對外必依 §05 揭露來源
en: AI plays the user through a journey. Tests behavior shape, not real motive. Does not replace research. Disclose source under §05.

zh: Proof of Concept；用合成用戶驗「流程走得通嗎」的階段。在 Design 出完畫面後、Build 之前進場
en: Proof of Concept: synthetic-user stage that checks “does the flow even walk.” After Design ships screens, before Build.

zh: POC 通過後招募真人用戶的小規模試驗。Research Agent 負責招募（screener／名單意圖）
en: Small live trial with real users after POC. Research Agent owns recruiting (screener / list intent).

zh: heuristic 驗證
en: heuristic check

zh: 合成用戶迴路的性質：測的是「行為形狀對不對」，不是真實動機。≠用戶研究
en: Nature of the synthetic-user loop: tests “is the behavior shape right,” not real motive. ≠ user research

zh: 四步迴路
en: Four-step loop

zh: 原料不可亂改 → LLM Wiki（可執行真相）→ 專責 agents；你是 Orchestrator
en: Raw material is immutable → LLM Wiki (executable truth) → specialist agents; you are Orchestrator

zh: ＝ Browser-as-User（Perplexity）；讀 wiki 後對抗跑旅程—demo 主線
en: = Browser-as-User (Perplexity); read the wiki, then run the journey adversarially—demo spine

zh: 你在迴路裡的角色：編排原料→wiki→agents，寫回 log。不是旁觀者，也不是讓 agent 自己跑
en: Your role in the loop: orchestrate raw → wiki → agents, write back to the log. Not a spectator. Not “let the agent run.”

zh: T4（模板）
en: T4 (template)

zh: 旅程 prompt 的四欄結構：角色／任務／情境限制／成功條件。只改欄位不動結構
en: Four-column journey prompt: role / task / situational constraints / success criteria. Change fields, not the structure.

zh: Claude Design 套 Design.md（＋tokens／system）；後段出 UI，不是從空白畫布發明判斷
en: Claude Design applies Design.md (+tokens / system); UI comes late. It does not invent judgment from a blank canvas.

zh: 負責 POC → Pilot 招募（screener／名單意圖），不是左欄 RAW 原料格
en: Owns POC → Pilot recruiting (screener / list intent), not the left-column RAW slot

zh: 28 文件裡約 86% markdown 主導（A+B）、14% Figma 原生（C）。合成用戶迴路前置吃 A＋B
en: Of 28 file types, ~86% markdown-led (A+B), 14% Figma-native (C). The synthetic-user loop eats A+B up front.

zh: 給 agent 讀的約束：品牌／元件名／語氣。真相源在 md／json，不只在 Figma；別從生成 frame 一鍵反解充當系統
en: Constraints agents read: brand / component names / tone. Source of truth is md / json, not only Figma. Do not reverse-engineer a generated frame into a system.
§05–§07 · Distill boundary

zh: 蒸餾
en: Distill

zh: 把判斷濃縮進 wiki／prompt corpus；原料歸誰＝邊界問題
en: Compress judgment into wiki / prompt corpus; who owns the raw material = the boundary question

zh: 邊界矩陣
en: Boundary matrix

zh: 依身份（受僱／接案／自有教材）標 ●可自由／◐需授權／○禁區—D1
en: By identity (employed / freelance / own teaching materials) mark ● free / ◐ licensed / ○ forbidden—D1

zh: 揭露聲明
en: Disclosure statement

zh: 四欄：工具·資料流向·審核·蒸餾聲明。範本＝D2；填好的實例＝D3
en: Four columns: tools · data flow · review · distill statement. Template = D2; filled instance = D3

zh: frontmatter：free | licensed | forbidden—蒸餾時強制標來源身份（D4）
en: frontmatter: free | licensed | forbidden—mandatory source-identity mark at distill time (D4)

zh: RACI · 每列一 A
en: RACI · one A per row

zh: §06 組織問責；決策者先指定兩格 A：範本推行、交付附聲明（D6）
en: §06 org accountability. The decision-maker first assigns two A cells: roll out the template, attach disclosure on delivery (D6)

zh: 矩陣·範本·聲明·distill·合約條款·問責表·帶走清單·禁入規則。當週最小集＝D2＋D5＋D6
en: Matrix · template · statement · distill · contract clause · accountability table · takeaway list · no-entry rules. This-week minimum set = D2+D5+D6

zh: 7.1–7.3 / 決策日誌
en: 7.1–7.3 / decision log

zh: 形態約束→多方案→判準→寫 log。沒 log，揭露第四欄沒有「被蒸餾的判斷」可聲明
en: Stack constraints → variants → criteria → write the log. No log, disclosure column 4 has no “distilled judgment” to declare

zh: 離場三題
en: Three exit questions

zh: 個人作品集與 AI 協作揭露 · 組織共享與著作權利 · 創業 POC 的法律灰區—須套進配置 A／B 才算落地
en: Personal portfolio and AI-collab disclosure · org sharing and copyright · legal grey of startup POC—only lands when mapped onto Config A / B

zh: 配置 A / B
en: Config A / B

zh: 軍事隱喻：AI 不是替代你，是放大你的判斷。正因放大，更要標清哪些是你選的、哪些是模型生成
en: Military metaphor: AI does not replace you. It amplifies your judgment. Precisely because it amplifies, mark what you chose vs what the model generated.

zh: Design 道 / Build 道
en: Design lane / Build lane
